status: specified before new test readouts and comparative results
development_disclosure: Public test outputs and the four diagnostic cases were inspected before this experiment. This is an exploratory mechanism study, not a blind confirmatory evaluation.

mask_readout.VID_source: Existing frozen FMP category-mask PNG; 256x256 nearest-neighbor export, with class index+1, zero background
mask_readout.screw_source: Existing frozen ZL1 packed binary screw masks, 160x224; these are the same masks previously used by the current screw readout
mask_readout.ownership: All same-class foreground pixels assigned to nearest bound instance center in native image coordinates; no detector box clipping; semantic instance count is immutable
mask_readout.axis: Native-coordinate PCA, endpoints at projection quantiles 0.01 and 0.99
mask_readout.unavailable: Keep original axis, record fallback; no object deletion, no normal imputation

quality.line_support: Mean membership of 64 equidistant axis samples in the assigned instance mask dilated by one mask pixel
quality.extent_coverage: Fraction of assigned foreground projections inside the candidate axis endpoint interval, extended by one native mask-pixel diagonal
quality.component_purity: Fraction of assigned foreground in its largest 8-connected component
quality.normal_DEV_floor: Global 10th percentile of readable mask-axis quality over all bound target objects in original-condition normal DEV, linear quantile
quality.selection: Use mask axis only when Q_mask >= frozen DEV floor and Q_mask >= Q_original + 0.05; otherwise retain original axis
quality.candidate_search: None. One declared selector, no per-category switches or post-test retries.

reference_modes.own_normal: Primary end-to-end comparison: identical original normal TRAIN/DEV interval fitting, TRAIN residual reference and independent CAL p95(higher), strict score > threshold; fit separately after each readout transformation
reference_modes.shared_original: Diagnostic comparison: retain original normal intervals, residual references and CAL thresholds; only test readouts change

report: macro AUROC/F1 at original task granularity
unique original/capture parents separately from capture-condition records
